title: Scientists confirm moon made of cheese
text: A viral post claims astronauts brought back cheese samples. No space agency has reported this.

title: Miracle drink cures all diseases overnight
text: The article cites no studies and the company behind it sells the product.

title: City opens new public library
text: The library opened on Monday with 50,000 books, the mayor's office confirmed.

title: Local team wins regional final
text: The match ended 2-1 and was broadcast live on regional television.

title: Tax rise will double prices next week
text: Taxes are rising, but official figures show an increase of about 3 percent, not double.

title: New law bans all cars downtown
text: The law limits some vehicles at peak hours but does not ban all cars.

title: Unnamed insider hints at merger

title: Rumours about celebrity wedding plans
